smoke.note: Measurement smoke: SV 10 min with [UnseenFallback] Enabled=1 and unseenfbstuck + unseenfbplan on: the stubs install (ufReady 15), the switches read back (fixes on ... verified), the minute line 'unseen fallback:' appears.

jobs.note: Phase B correctness: forced ABBA on unseenfb-stuck-far (30 Sims stranded on the farthest lot, one round-1 stuck check each per loop), 60 per arm, cap 10 min. Pass: no crash, 0 watchdog lines, unseenfb_stuck_deferred >= 30, no RunStuckCheckHelper sync-plan line >= 300 ms in on windows, stuck_check_reset 0. Read: off-arm probe plans and their long-job lines (the cost B removes).

Phase A correctness (positive): forced ABBA on unseenfb-far-crowd-loop (30 Sims sent home from the farthest community lot: own-START cross-town plans of unseen followers), 60 per arm, cap 12 min; the loop flips ufMode and unseenfbplan. Pass: no crash, 0 watchdog lines, ufMarks >= 30, ufJobCut + ufSyncCut >= 1, no 'sim waited >= 300 ms behind an own job' line in on windows for a capped (UnseenFallback) job, no Sim stuck at the end. Strict DeadlineMs (0.36.94, docs/202 §3.1.1): ufMaxUs must stay < 300 ms (the setting) and ufLong (marked >= the setting) 0: the cut point is the setting minus the learned overrun (minute line 'cut at <sync> / <job> ms', ufEffCutUs, ufOverP99Us), and a marked sync plan still waiting for +0x918 at its cut point fails before the search (ufLockFail). Read: the 'cut at' values, ufLockWaits / ufLockFail, unseenfb_noretry, unseenfb_refused (expect 0).

The same phase A loop with DeadlineMs=175 (the lowest player setting; every other job runs the release default 300). Pass as sv-ufb-farcrowd-loop; read (strict, 0.36.94): capped (UnseenFallback) lines and ufMaxUs < 175 ms, ufLong (>= the setting) 0, 'cut at' >= 87 ms (setting / 2 floor), more cuts than at 300 (cut share vs route-fail reactions = the trade-off the player picks).

Phase A negative (never acts on seen Sims): route-ownjob-yield-loop's crowd is on the household's lot (seen by rule) with unseenfbplan + [UnseenFallback] on for the whole run. Pass: no crash, unseenfb_seen >= 30, unseenfb_marked counts only townies away from the home lot (expect a few, not the crowd: ufMarks well below the crowd's plan count), unseenfbteleport_shortcuts 0.

Stuck-detector compatibility (docs/202 §3.7): repro unseenfb-overwatch-cuts (20 far Sims, 12 rounds of cut plans home from one spot, Overwatch's nightly pass before and after). Pass: no crash, owprobeplans_hidden grows (fixesRequire); judged by hand from the repro's before / after patches steps (repro.jsonl): owstucknotice_held unchanged inside the repro window, watchdog resets unchanged. unseenfb_cut reported, not required (phase A cuts do not fire in repros; validated in natural runs, v020-natural.json). No end-value owstucknotice_held rule: fixesRequire reads the session value at the run end, which includes ~6 min of free play after the repro where Overwatch resets natural Sims (docs/202 §5.3). Needs NRaas Overwatch in the test Mods (as the Overwatch jobs).

Teleport verify (verify-shortcut rule, docs/202 §3.2): SV natural 30 min, seeded, all three switches and [UnseenFallback] on for the whole run. Pass: no crash, unseenfbteleport_shortcuts >= 5, 0 stuck Sims among the moved ones (sims_activity + moved list, as verify-shortcut.ts), 0 watchdog lines. If it does not fire: rerun on IP (other world), no A/B.
